question: Where is café situated within 130 kilometers along the travel path toward Park Hyatt New York, New York, NY from Art Clinic, New York, NY?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Art Clinic%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 130000 -- 130 kilometers in meters ) AND ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Art Clinic%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) < ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Park Hyatt New York%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography );
